question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Go to the login page and click 'Forgot Password'. Enter your registered email address and follow the instructions sent to your inbox to reset your password.

question: My application is not loading. What should I do?
answer: Clear your browser cache and cookies, then refresh the page. If the issue persists, try a different browser or check your internet connection.

question: How do I update my account email address?
answer: Log in to your account, go to Settings > Profile, and update your email address. A verification link will be sent to the new email to confirm the change.

question: Why am I getting an 'Access Denied' error?
answer: This usually means your account lacks the required permissions. Contact your system administrator to grant you the necessary access rights.

question: How do I export my data from the application?
answer: Navigate to Settings > Data Management > Export. Choose your preferred file format (CSV or Excel) and click 'Export'. The file will be downloaded to your device.

question: The application is running very slowly. How can I fix this?
answer: Close unused browser tabs, clear your cache, and ensure your internet connection is stable. If the problem continues, try logging out and back in.

question: How do I add a new user to the system?
answer: Go to Admin Panel > User Management > Add User. Fill in the required details such as name, email, and role, then click 'Save'.

question: I accidentally deleted important data. Can it be recovered?
answer: Contact support immediately with the details of what was deleted. Data recovery is possible within 30 days depending on your plan and backup settings.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication (2FA)?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and toggle it on. Follow the setup steps to link your authenticator app or phone number.

question: Why is my file upload failing?
answer: Ensure the file size does not exceed the 25MB limit and the format is supported (PDF, JPG, PNG, DOCX). Also check your internet connection stability.

question: How do I change the language settings in the app?
answer: Go to Settings > Preferences > Language, select your preferred language from the dropdown menu, and click 'Save Changes'.

question: Can I use the application on my mobile device?
answer: Yes, the application is mobile-responsive and accessible via any modern browser. A dedicated mobile app is also available on iOS and Android.

question: How do I integrate the app with third-party tools like Slack or Zapier?
answer: Go to Settings > Integrations, search for the desired tool, and click 'Connect'. Follow the OAuth authorization steps to complete the integration.

question: I'm not receiving email notifications. How do I fix this?
answer: Check your spam/junk folder first. Then go to Settings > Notifications and verify your email preferences are enabled. Also whitelist noreply@ourapp.com.

question: How do I generate a usage report for my team?
answer: Navigate to Reports > Team Activity, set your desired date range and filters, then click 'Generate Report'. You can download it as PDF or CSV.

question: Why is my session expiring too quickly?
answer: Session timeout is set by your admin for security purposes. Go to Settings > Security and request an extension, or contact your administrator.

question: How do I assign a task to another team member?
answer: Open the task, click 'Assign To', and search for the team member's name. Select them and click 'Confirm Assignment'. They will receive a notification.

question: What should I do if I see a 500 Internal Server Error?
answer: This is a server-side issue. Refresh the page after a few minutes. If it persists for more than 10 minutes, report it to our support team with the error timestamp.

question: How do I create a custom dashboard?
answer: Go to Dashboard > Customize, click 'Add Widget', and choose from the available metrics and chart types. Drag and drop to arrange them as needed.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Go to Billing > Subscription > Cancel Plan. Follow the prompts to confirm cancellation. Your access will remain active until the end of the billing period.

question: How do I merge two duplicate accounts?
answer: Contact support with both account email addresses. Our team will verify ownership and merge the accounts, preserving all data from both.

question: The search function is not returning results. What's wrong?
answer: Ensure your search terms are spelled correctly. Try using broader keywords or filters. If results are still missing, clear your cache and try again.

question: How do I set up automated backups for my data?
answer: Go to Settings > Data Management > Backups, enable 'Automatic Backups', and choose your preferred frequency (daily, weekly, or monthly).

question: Why can't I log in even after resetting my password?
answer: Ensure Caps Lock is off and there are no spaces in the password. Try using an incognito window. If still blocked, your account may be locked — contact support.

question: How do I download an invoice for my subscription?
answer: Go to Billing > Invoice History, select the billing period you need, and click 'Download PDF'. Invoices are available for the past 24 months.
